svg.title: Kernel elapsed time: median milliseconds by scenario and runtime
svg.desc: Vertical bars show elapsed time. Shorter means faster. Every panel uses an independent linear scale starting at zero. Runtime labels and measured times identify each bar. Failed or unavailable results have no bar.

g.text: Shorter bars are faster · Linear axes start at zero · Each panel has its own scale
Compare runtimes within a panel, not bar heights across panels. Failures are not timings.
